items.title: affaan-m/ECC
items.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
items.author: affaan-m
items.summary_zh: affaan-m/ECC 是一个面向 Claude Code、Codex 和 Opencod 等 AI 编程助手的性能优化系统，它集成了技能、直觉、记忆、安全性和研究优先的开发理念，帮助开发者更高效地利用这些工具，让 AI 代理的运行更加稳定和智能。
items.summary_en: ECC is an agent harness performance optimization system designed for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Opencod. It bundles skills, instincts, memory, security, and a research-first development approach, enabling developers to fine-tune their agents for better stability and intelligence. This matters because it transforms raw AI tools into more reliable, context-aware programming partners.

items.title: microsoft/PowerToys
items.description: Microsoft PowerToys is a collection of utilities that supercharge productivity and customization on Windows
items.author: microsoft
items.summary_zh: 微软推出的 PowerToys 是一套专为 Windows 用户打造的系统增强工具集，包含窗口管理、批量文件重命名、颜色选取等实用功能，旨在大幅提升日常操作效率与系统自定义能力。对于追求高效工作流和个性化体验的 Windows 发烧友来说，这套开源工具堪称生产力利器。
items.summary_en: Microsoft PowerToys is a set of open-source utilities designed to supercharge Windows productivity and customization. It includes tools like FancyZones for window management, PowerRename for bulk file renaming, and Color Picker, all aimed at streamlining everyday tasks and enhancing system personalization. Power users and developers will find it invaluable for optimizing their workflow and tailoring Windows to their needs.

items.description: The open-source CapCut alternative
items.author: OpenCut-app
items.summary_zh: OpenCut 是一款开源的视频编辑工具，旨在成为 CapCut 的替代品。它完全免费，支持多平台使用，用户无需付费即可获得强大的剪辑功能。对于想要摆脱商业软件限制的创作者来说，OpenCut 提供了极高的可定制性和透明度，让视频编辑更加自由。
items.summary_en: OpenCut is an open-source video editor designed as a free alternative to CapCut. It offers powerful editing features without any subscription or watermark, making it ideal for content creators who want full control over their tools. The project is cross-platform and community-driven, ensuring transparency and continuous improvement. For anyone tired of paid video editors or restrictive platforms, OpenCut provides a flexible and privacy-respecting solution.

items.title: koala73/worldmonitor
items.description: Real-time global intelligence dashboard. AI-powered news aggregation, geopolitical monitoring, and infrastructure tracking in a unified situational awareness interface
items.author: koala73
items.summary_zh: 这是一个基于AI的实时全球情报仪表盘，能够聚合新闻、监控地缘政治事件并追踪基础设施状态，用户可以通过统一的界面全面了解世界动态。它的价值在于为需要快速掌握全球局势的分析师、记者和企业决策者提供了强大的实时信息工具。
items.summary_en: Worldmonitor is an AI-powered real-time global intelligence dashboard that aggregates news, monitors geopolitical events, and tracks infrastructure status in a single unified view. Designed for analysts, journalists, and business leaders, it enables rapid situational awareness and informed decision-making by consolidating diverse data streams into an accessible interface. Its significance lies in simplifying complex global monitoring and helping professionals stay ahead of critical developments.

items.title: ansible/ansible
items.description: Ansible is a radically simple IT automation platform that makes your applications and systems easier to deploy and maintain. Automate everything from code deployment to network configuration to cloud management, in a language that approaches plain English, using SSH, with no agents to install on remote systems. https://docs.ansible.com.
items.author: ansible
items.summary_zh: Ansible 是一个极其简洁的 IT 自动化平台，它使用人类可读的 YAML 描述系统配置，无需在目标机器上安装代理就可以完成服务器部署、应用发布和运维编排。对于那些希望用最少的精力实现大规模基础设施自动化的运维团队来说，Ansible 的简洁性和无代理架构带来了显著的生产力提升。
items.summary_en: Ansible is a radically simple IT automation platform that uses human-readable YAML playbooks to automate deployment, configuration management, and application delivery. Its agentless architecture means you don't need to install anything on managed nodes, drastically reducing setup effort. IT operations teams benefit most because it makes automating everything from server provisioning to application updates straightforward and repeatable. It's designed to let you manage thousands of machines with the same ease as one, solving the complexity of modern infrastructure at scale.

items.title: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks
items.description: Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5, Opus 5, Claude Design, Claude Code. OpenAI - ChatGPT GPT-5.6-Sol, Codex. Google - Gemini 3.5 Flash, 3.1 Pro, Antigravity. xAI - Grok, Cursor, Copilot, VS Code, Perplexity, and more. Updated regularly.
items.author: asgeirtj
items.summary_zh: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks 是一个 GitHub 项目，它收集了 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 多个大模型的系统提示词，包括 Claude Fable 5、Opus 4.8、ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking 等。这些提示词揭示了模型背后如何被引导、如何设定角色和限制，对 AI 研究者和开发者理解模型行为非常有价值。它引发了关于提示工程和模型安全边界的讨论，也是窥探顶级 AI 内部设计的一个窗口。
items.summary_en: This GitHub repository compiles leaked system prompts from popular AI models like Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Opus 4.8, as well as OpenAI's ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking and GPT 5.5 Instant. By exposing the hidden instructions that shape how these models behave, it offers rare insight into prompt engineering, safety guardrails, and role-setting techniques. AI researchers and developers can learn how top models are orchestrated, but the leak also raises important questions about access control and intellectual property in the generative AI race.

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
items.author: mvanhorn
items.summary_zh: 这是一个AI代理技能，能够跨Reddit、X、YouTube、Hacker News、Polymarket及整个网络搜索任意主题，并综合生成有据可依的摘要。它的独特之处在于聚合多源信息后给出带引用的总结，把散落在各平台的观点和事实整合成一份可信的简报。非常适合需要快速掌握某个话题舆论动向或最新进展的研究者、记者和投资者。
items.summary_en: This is an AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, and the broader web, then synthesizes a grounded summary with citations. Its strength lies in aggregating fragmented information from diverse platforms into a single, credible briefing, complete with references. This is a game-changer for researchers, journalists, and investors who need to quickly grasp the pulse of public opinion or the latest developments on a subject without manually combing through dozens of tabs.

items.title: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners
items.description: 12 Weeks, 24 Lessons, AI for All!
items.author: microsoft
items.summary_zh: 微软推出的《AI for Beginners》课程是一套为期12周、共24课时的免费学习资源，专为零基础学习者设计。课程覆盖机器学习、神经网络、计算机视觉等核心主题，结合实践项目，帮助初学者系统掌握人工智能基础。无论学生还是转行者，都能借此轻松入门AI领域。
items.summary_en: Microsoft's AI for Beginners is a free, structured curriculum that spans 12 weeks with 24 lessons, covering essential AI topics like machine learning, neural networks, and computer vision. It's designed for absolute beginners, offering hands-on projects and clear explanations. This repo makes AI education accessible to everyone, from students to career changers, providing a solid foundation without needing prior experience. It's a perfect starting point for anyone curious about artificial intelligence.

items.summary_zh: 情报虾是一款跨平台情报收集工具，通过skills能力一键扫荡小红书、微博和B站，把分散在不同平台的热点、趋势和用户反馈整合在一起。对运营、媒体人和市场研究人员来说，不必再手动切换多个应用，只需一个入口就能掌握全网络动态，大幅提升信息采集与分析的效率。
items.summary_en: Qingbao Xia is a cross-platform intelligence gathering tool that leverages skills to sweep Xiaohongshu, Weibo, and Bilibili in one click. It aggregates trending topics, user feedback, and insights from scattered platforms into a single dashboard. This saves social media operators, journalists, and market researchers from constant app switching, giving them a unified view of public sentiment and viral content. The tool matters because manual monitoring is slow and error-prone; automating collection lets teams focus on analysis and decision-making. Anyone tracking online trends or brand reputation would benefit from this practical automation.

items.title: AI Agent 不是唯一答案，Expedia 用确定性工作流打造 AI 运维平台
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了Expedia为何没有盲目追随AI Agent潮流，而是采用确定性工作流来构建AI运维平台。相比完全交给智能体自主决策，确定性流程更能保证操作的可控性与稳定性，特别适合处理线上故障排查、系统监控等高风险场景。它提醒我们，在某些运维任务中，明确规则与人工干预依然比全自动智能体更可靠。
items.summary_en: This article explains why Expedia chose deterministic workflows over AI Agents for its AI operations platform. Instead of letting autonomous agents make decisions, Expedia relies on predefined, predictable processes to ensure control and stability in high-risk scenarios like incident response and system monitoring. The key insight is that not every problem needs an intelligent agent; some operational tasks are better served by explicit rules and human oversight. This matters because it challenges the hype around agentic AI, showing that deterministic automation can be more reliable and easier to troubleshoot in production environments. DevOps teams and platform engineers would benefit from understanding when to choose workflow-based automation over flexible agents.

items.title: 从GPT-2到Kimi K3：七年规模扩大2.26万倍，大模型架构主线是在建立一套“记忆操作系统”
items.summary_zh: 文章回顾了从GPT-2到Kimi K3七年间大模型规模扩大2.26万倍的历程，指出架构演进的主线其实是在建立一套'记忆操作系统'。模型越来越大，本质上是为了更好地存储、调用和组织知识，就像操作系统管理内存与文件一样。这一视角帮助理解上下文窗口、注意力机制和检索增强等技术方向，对研究大模型发展脉络的人很有启发。
items.summary_en: This piece traces the evolution from GPT-2 to Kimi K3, noting that model scale has grown 22,600 times in seven years. The author argues that the main architectural trend is effectively building a 'memory operating system' for AI. As models grow larger, they better store, retrieve, and organize knowledge, much like an OS manages memory and files. This framing clarifies why research focuses on context windows, attention mechanisms, and retrieval augmentation. It offers a unifying perspective for understanding large model development and helps researchers, engineers, and tech observers see beyond raw parameter counts to the deeper challenge of memory management.

items.title: 办公虾：秒级部署！用skills联动办公软件，效率翻倍
items.summary_zh: 办公虾是一款专注办公效率的skills工具，可以秒级部署，迅速联动Excel、Word等办公软件，把重复性操作自动化。用户无需复杂编程，只需调用skills就能完成报表生成、文档处理等任务，效率翻倍。对于经常处理表格和文件的行政、财务、运营人员来说，是一个非常实用的轻量级自动化助手。
items.summary_en: Bangong Xia is a productivity-focused skills tool that deploys in seconds and connects with office software like Excel and Word. It automates repetitive tasks such as generating reports, formatting documents, and processing data, without requiring users to write complex code. By calling pre-built skills, administrative staff, finance professionals, and operations teams can double their efficiency and reduce manual errors. The tool matters because office automation is often gated by technical skill; this removes that barrier and makes workflow automation accessible to everyone. It is a lightweight, practical assistant for anyone who lives in spreadsheets and documents.

items.title: 深度访谈｜第二次权力转移：当Agent拿走数据库的行动权
items.summary_zh: 这篇深度访谈探讨了当AI Agent获得数据库操作权限后，权力结构正在发生第二次转移。过去决策权从业务人员转向IT部门，如今Agent可以直接读写数据、执行查询，意味着业务人员能更自主地获取洞察，但同时也带来了数据安全与治理的新挑战。文章适合关注数据平台、AI应用落地和企业治理的读者思考。
items.summary_en: This in-depth interview explores a 'second power shift' in enterprise data: AI Agents are now taking direct action on databases. Previously, decision-making moved from business users to IT departments; now agents can query, read, and write data autonomously, giving business users more independence and faster access to insights. However, this shift also raises serious concerns about data security, access control, and governance. The conversation is relevant for data platform teams, AI application developers, and enterprise leaders who must balance autonomy with accountability. It highlights the need for new guardrails as agents become more involved in operational decisions.

items.title: Superlogical
items.author: yan
items.summary_zh: Superlogical是一个通过自然语言描述来自动化逻辑推理和流程编排的工具。用户只需用简单的语言说明需求，它就能自动生成可执行的逻辑规则，适合处理复杂的决策树或业务规则。对于那些需要快速验证算法正确性，或者要在系统中嵌入逻辑推理能力的人来说，Superlogical降低了门槛。它像是一个懂你意图的逻辑引擎，把繁琐的规则编写变成对话式的体验。
items.summary_en: Superlogical is a tool that turns natural language descriptions into executable logic rules and workflows. Instead of manually coding complex decision trees or business rules, you simply describe what you want, and it handles the translation. This makes it a game‑changer for developers and analysts who need to quickly prototype or embed reasoning capabilities into their systems. It lowers the barrier for automating logic, transforming a traditionally tedious task into a conversational interaction. Think of it as a logic engine that understands your intent and builds the rules for you.

items.title: KOReader
items.author: Cider9986
items.summary_zh: 这款开源引擎能让任何搭载 M 系列芯片的 Mac 仅用 2GB 内存就跑动 Gemma 4 26B 大语言模型。通过极致的量化与内存优化技术，它打破了本地运行大型 AI 模型的高硬件门槛，让普通 Mac 用户也能尝试前沿研究。对于 AI 爱好者、学生和预算有限的开发者来说，这是一个令人兴奋的突破，意味着更低的实验成本和更便捷的本地推理体验。
items.summary_en: This open-source engine makes it possible to run the large language model Gemma 4 26B on any M-series Mac with just 2GB of RAM. Through aggressive quantization and memory optimization, it lowers the hardware barrier for running cutting-edge AI locally. This is a game-changer for AI enthusiasts, students, and developers with limited resources, enabling them to experiment and develop applications without expensive cloud GPUs or high-end workstations.

items.title: Substack writers, you need a website
items.author: speckx
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章提醒Substack作者，不要完全依赖平台，应该建立自己的独立网站来掌控内容和读者关系。虽然Substack方便快捷，但一旦平台政策变动或者账号出现问题，你的读者和数据都可能受到影响。通过自己的网站，你可以拥有更自由的变现方式、更直接的互动渠道，还能避免算法流量的不确定性。对于认真写内容、想长期经营的创作者来说，这不仅是备份，更是品牌护城河。
items.summary_en: This article argues that Substack writers should invest in their own independent websites rather than relying solely on the platform. While Substack offers convenience, it also comes with risks like policy changes, algorithmic unpredictability, and potential account issues that could leave you disconnected from your audience. By owning a website, you gain full control over your content, monetization, and reader relationships. It acts as a brand fortress, ensuring your work isn't held hostage by a single platform. Serious creators looking for long-term stability and deeper audience engagement will find this advice essential.

items.title: Prefactor
items.description: Evaluate your AI Agents in real-time
items.summary_zh: Prefactor 是一款实时评估AI代理性能的工具，它让开发者可以持续监控智能体的行为，及时发现异常并优化部署。对于正在构建生产级AI系统的团队来说，它解决了“黑箱”问题，确保代理在真实环境中稳定可靠地运行。无论是聊天机器人还是自动化流程，Prefactor 都能提供关键的洞察。
items.summary_en: Prefactor is a tool that evaluates AI agents in real time, allowing developers to continuously monitor agent behavior, catch anomalies early, and optimize deployments. For teams building production-grade AI systems, it solves the black-box problem, ensuring agents run stably and reliably in real-world environments. Whether for chatbots or automated workflows, Prefactor provides critical insights.

items.title: AI's top startups are barely publishing their research
items.author: YeGoblynQueenne
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章指出，顶尖AI创业公司目前几乎不再公开发表研究成果，这标志着从学术界开放传统向工业界保密策略的明显转变。这种趋势引发了关于可复现性、研究透明度和技术共享的担忧，对于依赖前沿公开成果的研究人员和行业观察者来说，了解其影响至关重要。
items.summary_en: Top AI startups are increasingly keeping their research under wraps, a stark departure from the open publication culture of academia. This piece explores how the shift toward corporate secrecy affects reproducibility, transparency, and the broader AI ecosystem. Researchers and industry observers who rely on published breakthroughs to guide their work will find this analysis particularly relevant, as it raises important questions about the future of knowledge sharing in a field that once thrived on collective progress.

items.title: Codex Security
items.author: bakigul
items.summary_zh: Codex Security是一款面向开发团队的安全分析工具，专注于在代码层面发现漏洞并提供自动修复建议。它深度集成到开发流程中，能在代码提交前就预警安全问题，减少事后补漏洞的麻烦。对于追求DevSecOps的团队来说，这款工具可以帮助他们把安全左移，在不牺牲速度的前提下提升代码质量。它的独特之处在于结合了静态分析与上下文理解，从而减少误报，让开发者更愿意使用。
items.summary_en: Codex Security is a developer‑friendly security analysis tool that catches vulnerabilities in code before they reach production. It integrates directly into the CI/CD pipeline, offering automated remediation suggestions rather than just raw warnings. By combining static analysis with contextual understanding, it significantly reduces false positives—a major pain point for busy developers. Teams aiming for a smooth DevSecOps workflow will appreciate how it shifts security left without slowing down delivery. The tool is designed to be unobtrusive, helping developers write safer code while staying productive.

items.title: Prelint
items.description: Prevent product drift in AI-written code
items.summary_zh: Prelint是一款专门防止AI生成代码出现“产品漂移”的检查工具。当AI编写的代码虽然语法正确却偏离了业务需求时，Prelint能通过自定义规则和语义分析提前拦截这类问题。它特别适合在使用Copilot、Codex等AI编码助手的团队中充当质检关口，确保生成的代码不仅跑得通，还能真正满足产品需求。对于想放心利用AI提速又不想牺牲产品质量的开发者来说，Prelint是缺不了的安全网。
items.summary_en: Prelint is a linter purpose‑built for AI‑generated code, tackling the growing problem of product drift—where code compiles and runs but subtly strays from business requirements. It uses custom rules and semantic analysis to catch these mismatches before they hit production. For teams relying on AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot or OpenAI Codex, Prelint acts as a quality gate, ensuring the output aligns with actual product intent. Developers who want to accelerate with AI without sacrificing accuracy will find it an indispensable safety net. It bridges the gap between fast code generation and reliable software delivery.

items.title: SKI
items.description: Free voice coding for Claude Code, Codex and more
items.summary_zh: SKI是一款免费语音编程工具，支持Claude Code、Codex等主流AI编程助手，让开发者直接用自然语言口述代码指令，无需动手输入。它解决了程序员因键盘操作导致的肢体疲劳问题，同时也为行动不便的群体提供了更友好的编程方式。最吸引人的是它完全免费，降低了尝试门槛，是追求高效无障碍编程体验者的实用选择。
items.summary_en: SKI is a free voice coding tool that works with popular AI assistants like Claude Code and Codex, letting developers dictate commands and code instructions naturally instead of typing. It addresses common issues like repetitive strain injuries and accessibility barriers, making programming more inclusive and comfortable. The fact that it's free lowers the entry barrier significantly, so anyone curious about hands-free development can simply plug it in and start speaking. For developers with physical discomfort or those just wanting a more ergonomic workflow, SKI offers a practical and approachable solution.

items.title: SoundGate Guitar
items.description: AI Music Tutor that gives real-time feedback on your playing
items.summary_zh: SoundGate Guitar是一款AI音乐导师，它能够在用户弹奏吉他时实时分析音准、节奏和技巧，并给出精准的纠正建议。对于初学者来说，这相当于拥有了一个24小时在线的私人教练，无需再依赖昂贵的线下课程。而进阶玩家也能通过它发现细微的演奏瑕疵，提升表现力。这款工具巧妙地将人工智能与音乐教育结合，解决了传统自学缺乏即时反馈的痛点，让练琴变得高效又有趣。
items.summary_en: SoundGate Guitar is an AI music tutor that provides real-time feedback on your guitar playing. It analyzes pitch, rhythm, and technique as you play, offering instant corrections and suggestions. For beginners, this eliminates the need for expensive in-person lessons, giving them a personal coach available around the clock. Advanced players can use it to refine subtle imperfections and improve expressiveness. By combining artificial intelligence with music education, SoundGate solves the core problem of self-learning—the lack of immediate feedback—making practice sessions both effective and engaging.

items.title: AI Search Console
items.description: Prompt analytics and citation mapping for AI search
items.summary_zh: AI Search Console是一款专门为AI搜索时代打造的提示词分析和引用映射工具。它能帮助品牌和内容创作者追踪自己的内容在ChatGPT、Perplexity等AI搜索引擎中被引用的情况，查看哪些提示词触发了品牌提及，以及竞争对手的可见度如何。对于SEO专业人员、内容营销人员和关注品牌在线影响力的人来说，这是一款极具针对性的数据洞察平台。
items.summary_en: AI Search Console provides prompt analytics and citation mapping for the fast-growing world of AI-powered search. It lets brands and content creators see exactly how their material gets referenced inside AI chatbots like ChatGPT and Perplexity, which prompts trigger brand appearances, and how they compare to competitors. This addresses the emerging challenge of tracking visibility in answer engines rather than traditional Google results. For SEO professionals, content marketers, and brand managers who want to understand their footprint in the AI search landscape, this tool offers essential clarity and actionable data in one focused dashboard.

items.title: Memmy Agent
items.description: Let every AI remember the same you.
items.summary_zh: Memmy Agent致力于解决AI记忆碎片化的问题，它创建一个统一的用户记忆层，让不同的AI助手和工具都能记住同一个你。无论你使用ChatGPT、Claude还是其他AI产品，你的偏好、背景信息和上下文都能被共享，从而获得高度个性化的连贯体验。对于重度AI用户和追求跨平台一致性的专业人士来说，这款工具能极大提升效率，减少重复介绍和重新设置带来的麻烦。
items.summary_en: Memmy Agent builds a unified memory layer that lets every AI tool remember the same version of you. Instead of each chatbot or assistant starting from scratch, your preferences, background details, and context are shared across platforms, so the experience feels continuous and genuinely personal. This solves a common frustration for heavy AI users who constantly have to repeat themselves or lose important context when switching tools. Professionals who juggle multiple AI assistants in daily workflows will benefit the most, as Memmy reduces redundancy and makes every interaction more informed and tailored. It's an elegant step toward making AI truly understand you, not just handle isolated requests.

items.title: Cekura
items.description: The self-improvement loop for voice agents
items.summary_zh: Cekura 是一款专为语音代理设计的自我改进循环工具，它通过自动记录和分析语音交互中的错误与成功案例，帮助开发者持续优化语音助手的表现。这个工具的核心价值在于让语音代理能够像人类一样从每次对话中学习，从而提升准确率和用户体验。对于那些正在构建客服、智能家居或车载语音系统的团队来说，Cekura 可以大幅减少手动调试和标注的时间，让迭代变得更加高效。
items.summary_en: Cekura is a self-improvement loop designed specifically for voice agents, automatically logging and analyzing every interaction to identify errors and successes. By enabling voice assistants to learn from each conversation, it helps developers continuously refine performance without manual intervention. This tool is particularly valuable for teams building customer service bots, smart home assistants, or in-car voice systems, as it significantly reduces debugging and annotation time, making iterative improvements faster and more data-driven.

items.title: Lottie Creator 2.0
items.description: After Effects for the web, built on Lottie
items.summary_zh: Lottie Creator 2.0 是一款基于 Lottie 的网页版动画制作工具，被誉为“网页上的 After Effects”。它让设计师无需安装专业软件，直接在浏览器中创建和编辑矢量动画，并导出轻量级的 Lottie 文件。这对前端工程师和 UI 设计师来说是个福音，因为动画文件更小、性能更好，而且可以无缝嵌入到网站和移动应用中。新版本还增加了更丰富的编辑功能和性能优化，进一步降低了高质量动画的制作门槛。
items.summary_en: Lottie Creator 2.0 is a web-based animation tool built on the Lottie framework, often described as After Effects for the browser. It allows designers to create and edit vector animations directly in their browser without installing heavy desktop software, and export lightweight Lottie files. This is a game-changer for front-end developers and UI designers because the resulting animations are small, performant, and seamlessly integrate into websites and mobile apps. The 2.0 version introduces richer editing capabilities and performance improvements, further lowering the barrier to producing high-quality animations.

items.title: Denovo
items.description: Turn your vibe-coded app into paying customers
items.summary_zh: Denovo是一款帮助开发者把vibe coding快速搭建出的应用转化为实际收入的工具。很多用自然语言生成的代码原型往往停留在demo阶段，Denovo提供支付、订阅、用户管理等商业化功能集成，让这些应用能够轻松实现收费闭环。对于独立开发者、创业团队以及AI产品爱好者来说，这是连接创意原型与可持续商业模式的桥梁，能显著加速产品变现过程并验证市场价值。
items.summary_en: Denovo helps developers turn vibe-coded apps—those quickly built with natural language prompts—into actual sources of revenue. While many such prototypes never leave the demo stage, Denovo provides easy integration for payments, subscriptions, user management, and other monetization essentials, completing the leap from fun experiment to viable business. It's designed for indie hackers, startup founders, and AI enthusiasts who want to validate their ideas without wrestling with complex billing infrastructure. By removing the friction around getting paid, Denovo lets builders focus on what they care about: making a product people love. This is a legitimate bridge between rapid AI-assisted creation and sustainable commercial success.

items.title: Claude Code usage tracking by LangWatch
items.description: See what your Claude Code sessions actually cost
items.summary_zh: LangWatch 新推出的工具专门为 Claude Code 会话提供成本追踪服务，让开发者清楚知道每次编码会话实际花了多少钱。它能拆解 API 调用、token 消耗和耗时，帮助个人开发者或团队更好地控制 AI 编程预算，优化使用效率。对于重度依赖 Claude Code 的用户来说，这是一款非常实用的成本管理利器。
items.summary_en: LangWatch has launched a new tool that tracks the real cost of your Claude Code sessions, breaking down API calls, token usage, and time spent. It helps developers and teams understand exactly what they're spending on AI coding, so they can manage budgets and optimize usage more effectively. For anyone relying heavily on Claude Code, this is a handy cost-control layer that turns vague anxiety about bills into clear, actionable data.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者从Cursor切换到Amazon Codex使用了半个多月，分享了两者的本质差异。Cursor让他第一次感受到AI编程的震撼，但Codex让他真正觉得AI不再只是辅助工具，而是一个能独立执行任务的超级Agent。作者认为Codex更接近下一阶段AI编程的形态，从对话式补全进化到主动式代理，对追求最前沿编程体验的开发者有重要参考价值。
items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Amazon Codex for over half a month, a developer shared their real experience of the fundamental differences. While Cursor first impressed them with AI-assisted coding, Codex felt like a true super agent that can independently execute tasks, not just an assistant. The author believes Codex represents the next phase of AI programming—evolving from conversational completion to proactive agency. This comparison is invaluable for developers seeking the cutting edge in AI-powered coding tools.

items.title: 小程序上线半年我赚了多少钱？
items.description: 1. 开发历程 时间过得真快，转眼间福猪记账小程序上线已经有半年时间了，从v1.0.0 版本做到了 v1.6.1 版本。今天整理了开发日志，真的不敢相信自己在工作之余能够把它做出来并上线。 2.用户积
items.summary_zh: 一位独立开发者分享了他业余开发的记账小程序“福猪记账”上线半年来的真实收入与运营数据。从v1.0.0迭代到v1.6.1，他记录了开发日志、用户增长曲线和盈利情况。这篇文章不仅展示了个人开发者利用业余时间做产品的可能性，也提供了从零到一、从技术到商业的完整复盘，特别适合想试试副业的程序员参考。
items.summary_en: An indie developer shared the real revenue and operational data of his expense tracking mini-program called 'Fuzhu' over six months since launch. He iterated from v1.0.0 to v1.6.1, documenting development logs, user growth, and profitability. This article demonstrates the possibility of building a product in spare time, offering a complete postmortem from coding to business. It’s especially useful for programmers exploring side projects.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了在AI能写出80%代码的背景下，技术面试如何从考察基础原理转向考察程序员的独特价值。面试官默认你熟悉AI工具，他们更看重问题拆解、业务理解、架构思维和人机协作能力，提醒开发者要聚焦AI无法替代的核心竞争力。
items.summary_en: The article explores how technical interviews have transformed as AI now writes 80% of the code. Interviewers assume proficiency with AI tools and instead evaluate skills that make developers irreplaceable: problem decomposition, business understanding, architectural thinking, and effective human-AI collaboration. It cautions against over-reliance on AI-generated code and urges developers to cultivate uniquely human competencies for long-term career relevance.

items.title: 写给年轻程序员的几点建议-2
items.description: 现在互联网红利已经消失了，深知年轻程序员的不易，下面就浅薄地谈几点建议。中国人口基数比较大，要培养自己的 商业嗅觉。你能卖爆一个商品，就能获得巨大的财富。微信公众号如果能写出 几万 浏览量的文章，就有
items.summary_zh: 作者针对互联网红利消退的现状，向年轻程序员提出培养商业嗅觉和写作能力的建议。他认为在中国庞大的人口基数下，能卖爆一个商品或写出高阅读量的公众号文章就能获得巨大财富。文章强调技术之外的市场认知和内容表达能力同样重要，适合处于职业早期的程序员思考如何拓宽收入来源。
items.summary_en: The author offers advice for young programmers in the post-internet-bonus era, emphasizing the need to develop business acumen and writing skills. Given China's huge population, successfully selling a product or writing a viral WeChat article can bring significant wealth. The article argues that market insight and content communication are as crucial as technical skills, making it relevant for early-career programmers looking to diversify their income streams.

items.title: 最近公司烧token比招员工还贵，老板干懵了...
items.description: 如题。 这真的没在开玩笑。 这也是最近不少公司，在大力、甚至全面拥抱 AI 之后所发出的切实吐槽。 一个月前，Uber 的 CTO 曾对外透露，公司自部署 CC 以来，内部有超 9 成的工程师在高频率
items.summary_zh: 这不是段子，是真实发生在许多公司里的窘境。随着全面拥抱AI，员工高频调用大模型API，公司的token消耗费用竟然超过了招聘新员工的成本。Uber的CTO曾透露，内部有超过九成的工程师在频繁使用AI服务。老板们面对账单直呼头疼：本来是降本增效的AI，怎么成了新的烧钱黑洞？
items.summary_en: This isn't a joke—it's a real dilemma many companies are facing. After wholeheartedly adopting AI, their token usage costs have actually surpassed the expense of hiring new employees. Uber's CTO revealed that over 90% of their engineers are using AI services heavily. Bosses are staring at the bills in shock: the technology that was supposed to reduce costs and boost efficiency has instead become a new money-burning black hole.

items.title: 2026编程圈很火的10个Skills
items.description: 前言 最近编程圈最火的一个词，非 Skills 莫属。 不是指程序员的技术能力，而是指 AI 编程助手的“技能包” 。 一套让 AI 从“随缘写代码”变成“按流程交付”的标准化工作流模块。 今天这篇文
items.summary_zh: 2026 年编程圈热议的 10 个 Skills 并非指程序员的技术能力，而是 AI 编程助手的“技能包”——一套标准化工作流模块，让 AI 从随缘写代码变为按流程交付。这些技能包覆盖代码审查、测试生成、文档编写等环节，旨在提升开发效率和代码质量。对正在探索 AI 辅助编程的团队和个人开发者而言，掌握这些技能包将成为提高生产力的关键。
items.summary_en: The 10 hottest Skills in programming circles for 2026 refer not to developers' own abilities but to standardized workflow modules for AI coding assistants. These skill packages transform AI from random code generation to structured delivery, covering code review, test generation, documentation, and more. For teams and individual developers exploring AI-assisted programming, mastering these skills is becoming essential for boosting productivity and code quality.

items.title: 三年了，为什么 AI 应用还没爆发？
items.description: 最近meta讲了个算力过剩的鬼故事，AI 股市应声暴跌，大家都很焦虑。 都在问这场 AI 游戏还能不能继续，AI 应用到底什么时候爆发，AI的抖音微信小红书什么时候才出现，AI会不会重蹈 2000 年
items.summary_zh: Meta 提出算力过剩观点后 AI 股市应声下跌，引发行业焦虑。文章反思 AI 应用三年未爆发的原因：基础设施投入巨大但 killer app 缺失，用户对 ChatGPT 等工具的新鲜感消退，而企业级落地面临成本和安全挑战。作者认为 AI 不会重蹈互联网泡沫，但需要找到像抖音微信那样的超级场景才能引爆下一波增长。
items.summary_en: When Meta suggested there was too much computing capacity, AI stocks tumbled, revealing deep anxiety in the industry. This article reflects on why AI applications haven't exploded after three years: massive infrastructure spending without a killer app, declining novelty of chatbots like ChatGPT, and enterprise deployment hurdles around cost and security. The author argues it's not a repeat of the 2000 dot-com bubble, but AI needs its own TikTok or WeChat moment to trigger the next growth wave. It's a sobering reality check for the industry.

items.title: Kimi K3太牛了！但老板说API太贵，让我本地化部署，我算完成本，他涨红脸沉默不语了！其实成本不高，三千万足矣。
items.description: 我看着老板的脸色由白转红，又有点儿紫，最后有点儿黑，没说一句话。沉默良久以后老板开口说：小X啊，这个事儿公司需要开会讨论一下，你把材料留下先回去吧。走出办公室的一刻，我看着老板拿起那份账单...
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述了一位程序员因公司使用Kimi K3 API成本过高，被老板要求研究本地化部署方案。他精心计算后，发现搭建一套能够承载同等性能的本地系统其实需要三千万人民币，而不是老板想象的低成本。当他把账单放在桌上，老板的脸色从白转红、再转紫最后变黑，沉默良久后让员工先回去等开会讨论。这个故事生动揭示了AI大模型商用部署的现实困境：看似便宜的API背后隐藏着高昂的调用成本，而自建基础设施的门槛更是高得惊人。
items.summary_en: This story recounts a programmer who was asked by his boss to explore local deployment of Kimi K3 after the API costs proved too expensive. After careful calculation, he discovered that building an on-premise system matching the same performance would actually cost 30 million yuan—far more than the boss expected. When he presented the bill, the boss's face turned from white to red, then purplish, and finally black; after a long silence, he told the employee to leave the documents and wait for a meeting. The tale vividly illustrates the harsh reality of deploying large AI models commercially: low API prices hide huge cumulative costs, while self-hosting demands astronomical investment.

items.title: 携程员工：在携程4年，月薪3万左右，基本没涨薪了。不过挺满足的，毕竟稳定，福利也不错（附Agent面试题）
items.description: 携程员工爆料4年月薪3万没涨薪但满足，14道Coding Agent面试题全解：Prompt组装、上下文三层压缩、Tool与Skill区别、多Agent编排、Plan设计，附源码级回答。
items.summary_zh: 一位携程员工透露自己在公司四年月薪约三万元且几乎没涨过，但他表示挺满足，因为工作稳定、福利不错。文章还附带了14道 Coding Agent 面试题的源码级解析，涵盖 Prompt 组装、上下文三层压缩、Tool 与 Skill 区别、多 Agent 编排、Plan 设计等，对准备 AI 智能体相关岗位的开发者很有参考价值。
items.summary_en: A Ctrip employee shared that after four years at the company, his salary is still around 30,000 yuan a month with almost no raises, yet he feels satisfied because the job is stable and benefits are good. The post also includes detailed source-level answers to 14 Coding Agent interview questions, covering prompt assembly, three-layer context compression, the difference between tools and skills, multi-agent orchestration, and plan design. Developers prepping for AI agent roles will find this a valuable reference.

items.title: 如何看待 OpenAI 将 GPT-5.6Luna 和 Terra 价格大幅度下调？大模型会进入价格战时代吗？
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 大幅下调 GPT-5.6 Luna 和 Terra 的价格，引发关于大模型是否进入价格战时代的讨论。降价意味着 OpenAI 试图以更低成本抢占市场份额，也反映出模型推理成本在持续下降。对开发者和企业来说是利好，但行业竞争加剧，中小模型厂商可能面临更大压力，未来价格战或成常态。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's significant price cut for GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra has sparked debate over whether large models are entering an era of price wars. Lower prices suggest OpenAI is trying to capture more market share, and they also reflect continued declines in inference costs. This is good news for developers and enterprises, but intensifying competition could put smaller model providers under real pressure. A sustained price war across the industry may become the new normal.

items.title: 媒体曝因 AI 裁员企业超半数承认决策失误，是真的吗？为啥这些企业光速反悔了？AI 裁员浪潮结束了吗？
items.summary_zh: 媒体报道显示，因 AI 而裁员的公司中超过半数承认当初决策失误，许多企业已迅速反悔，重新招聘。原因在于他们高估了 AI 的即时产出能力，忽略了人类员工在复杂场景下的判断力和协作价值。这说明 AI 裁员浪潮并未真正结束，但企业开始从盲目用 AI 替代人力转向人机协作的理性调整。
items.summary_en: Media reports suggest that more than half of companies that laid off workers due to AI now admit their decision was a mistake, and many are quickly reversing course. The reason is they overestimated AI's immediate productivity while overlooking human judgment and collaboration in complex scenarios. This doesn't mean the AI layoff wave is completely over, but companies are shifting from blindly replacing people with AI toward more rational human-AI collaboration.

items.title: SK 海力士跌超 17%，创最大跌幅纪录，AI 芯片投资热潮下，芯片巨头海力士股价为啥崩了？
items.summary_zh: SK 海力士股价暴跌超过17%，创下史上最大单日跌幅，引发市场震动。尽管 AI 芯片投资火热，但股价崩溃主要源于市场对内存芯片需求增长放缓的担忧，以及前期涨幅过大后的获利回吐。再加上行业竞争加剧和宏观不确定性，投资者对高估值产生疑虑，迫使芯片巨头股价大幅回调。
items.summary_en: SK Hynix's stock plunged over 17%, marking its biggest single-day drop ever and shaking the market. Despite the ongoing AI chip investment boom, the collapse stems from growing worries about slowing memory chip demand growth, plus profit-taking after a massive rally. Intensifying competition and macroeconomic uncertainty have also made investors question high valuations, forcing the chip giant's shares into a sharp correction.

items.title: 如何看待网传支付宝体验技术部被拆分，员工分散到各业务线，统一切换为「Agent 开发全栈工程师」？
items.summary_zh: 网传支付宝体验技术部被拆分，员工被分散到各业务线，并统一切换为「Agent 开发全栈工程师」。这反映出前端体验岗位正被AI重构，传统UI开发向智能体编排与全栈能力融合。对企业而言是降本增效，对个人则意味着技能栈必须扩展，否则面临边缘化。此举或许预示着大厂技术组织形态将围绕AI代理重新洗牌。
items.summary_en: Reports say Alipay split its experience technology department, redistributing staff across business lines and converting them all into "agent full-stack engineers." This signals a big shift in front-end and UX engineering: instead of building static interfaces, developers now orchestrate AI agents and integrate them with backend systems. The move reflects cost pressure and AI-driven productivity gains, but it also poses a career challenge—engineers must broaden their skills quickly. It could foreshadow how large tech companies restructure technical organizations around AI agents, making specialized UI teams less necessary.

items.title: deepseek 能否用来翻译书？
items.summary_zh: 关于DeepSeek能否用来翻译书，讨论认为完全可行但需谨慎。它能快速生成流畅初译，大幅降低时间和成本，尤其适合技术文档、通俗小说等非文学类内容。但文学翻译需要风格、韵味和文化语境，机器仍易翻车，需要人工校对和润色。结论是把DeepSeek当作高效助理而非替代译者，才是现实路径。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek can certainly be used to translate books, but with caveats. It produces fluid first drafts quickly, cutting time and cost dramatically—especially for technical manuals, business documents, and popular fiction where accuracy and clarity matter more than style. However, literary translation still poses a challenge: capturing tone, wordplay, and cultural nuance requires human sensibility. Machine output can sound flat or subtly wrong in context. The practical approach is to use DeepSeek as an efficient assistant, then have experienced editors polish the result. For non-literary works, it may be good enough with light revision; for serious literature, it remains a tool, not a replacement.

items.title: 都说美国制造业不行，那怎么 SpaceX 表现出极高的制造业水平？
items.summary_zh: 有人说美国制造业衰落，但SpaceX却展示了惊人的制造水平，这并不矛盾。SpaceX的强项不在传统大批量生产，而在高度垂直整合、快速迭代和工程创新，比如不锈钢火箭、猛禽发动机的量产化和可复用设计。它证明美国在尖端、复杂系统制造上仍有统治力，只是普通消费品制造已经转移。制造业不行与极强可以同时存在于不同赛道。
items.summary_en: The claim that U.S. manufacturing is weak seems contradicted by SpaceX's impressive production capabilities—but the two can coexist. SpaceX excels not in mass consumer goods, but in vertically integrated, fast-iterating engineering for complex systems: stainless-steel rockets, mass-producible Raptor engines, and reusable vehicles. Its approach emphasizes rapid prototyping, in-house fabrication, and aggressive cost reduction, proving that American manufacturing remains world-class in high-tech, high-complexity niches. Traditional manufacturing like clothing, gadgets, and basic components moved overseas long ago. So "declining" manufacturing and "extraordinary" manufacturing both describe the U.S. accurately, just in different sectors.

items.title: 商务部回应美拟对中国人工智能企业开展调查并制裁，称此为典型的人工智能霸权主义行径，如何看待美国此举？
items.summary_zh: 针对美国拟对中国AI企业发起调查和制裁，商务部回应称这是典型的人工智能霸权主义行径。这种作法以安全为名，实则打压他国技术发展，破坏全球AI产业链合作与公平竞争。美国试图通过政治手段维持技术垄断，但反而会加速中国AI自主创新和国产替代。国际市场规则被工具化，长期看对全球技术进步没有好处。
items.summary_en: In response to U.S. plans to investigate and sanction Chinese AI firms, China's commerce ministry called the move typical "AI hegemony." While framed as national security, the action appears designed to suppress rivals and preserve U.S. technological dominance. It disrupts global AI supply chains and undermines fair competition. Analysts note that such pressure often backfires, pushing Chinese companies to accelerate self-reliance in chips, frameworks, and applications. Instrumentalizing trade rules for geopolitical ends harms the entire industry, raising costs and slowing innovation worldwide. For startups on both sides, this means greater uncertainty and a fragmented AI landscape.

items.title: 目前 AI 最强到什么程度？
items.summary_zh: 目前AI的最强能力已远超普通人的日常认知：大模型能写代码、做数学推理、处理长文本、生成高质量图像视频，还能调用工具自主完成复杂任务。但它的强是窄而深的，依赖训练数据，缺乏真正的理解与常识，也会一本正经地胡说八道。最震撼的不只是单个模型能力，而是智能体与多模态结合后的自动化潜力。目前AI更像一个超强助手，离通用智能还有距离。
items.summary_en: Today's AI is far more capable than most people realize. Large models can write production code, solve challenging math problems, analyze long documents, and generate realistic images and video—and when connected to tools, they can autonomously execute multi-step tasks. This feels almost magical. Yet the strength is narrow and brittle: AI depends on training data, has no genuine understanding, and can confidently produce nonsense. The real breakthrough isn't just one model, but the combination of agents, multimodal input, and automation, which is starting to reshape knowledge work. Still, it remains a super-powered assistant, not general intelligence—impressive but fundamentally limited.

items.title: Android Developer Verification: Threat masquerading as protection
items.author: drewfax
items.summary_zh: 一位安全研究员揭露了 Android 开发者验证流程中存在的严重安全隐患：这一本意是保护开发者账户的机制，反而可能被攻击者利用来冒充合法开发者。通过分析验证逻辑中的漏洞，攻击者可以绕过程序窃取身份或发布恶意应用。这相当于把保护门禁变成了入侵的梯子。对于 Android 生态中的所有开发者而言，这个问题值得高度警惕，因为它动摇了整个应用签名和身份信任体系的基础。
items.summary_en: A security researcher reveals that Android's Developer Verification process—designed to protect developers—can be exploited by attackers to impersonate legitimate developers. By analyzing flaws in the verification logic, adversaries can bypass protections, steal identities, or distribute malicious apps under trusted names. This turns a protective gate into an entry point for intrusion. The finding undermines the trust foundation of Android's app signing and identity system, making it a critical concern for every developer in the ecosystem.

items.title: Apple sues OpenAI, accuses ex-employees of stealing trade secrets
items.author: stock_toaster
items.summary_zh: 苹果公司近日对OpenAI提起民事诉讼，指控多名前员工在离职时窃取了与人工智能研发相关的商业机密。这些员工据称带走了内部技术文档和核心算法，并可能用于竞争项目。这起诉讼不仅反映了硅谷两大科技巨头在人才和知识产权上的激烈争夺，也凸显了AI领域日益敏感的技术保密问题。对于科技行业观察者而言，这场法律战的结果或许会重塑企业防范员工跳槽时的保密协议设计。
items.summary_en: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that several former employees stole trade secrets related to artificial intelligence research. The complaint claims these workers took proprietary technical documents and core algorithms before leaving for positions that could benefit competing projects. This legal battle underscores the fierce competition for talent and intellectual property between two Silicon Valley giants, and highlights the growing sensitivity of technology secrecy in the AI industry. For tech observers, the outcome may influence how companies craft confidentiality agreements to guard against employee poaching.

items.title: EU Parliament greenlights Chat Control 1.0
items.author: rapnie
items.summary_zh: 欧盟议会通过了备受争议的Chat Control 1.0法案，要求数字平台扫描并报告涉及儿童性虐待材料的私密通信内容。这项立法引发了隐私与安全之间的激烈辩论，支持者认为它有助于保护儿童，而反对者警告这可能破坏端到端加密并开创大规模监控的先例。对于关注数字权利和隐私保护的群体来说，这是一个需要密切关注的发展。
items.summary_en: The European Parliament has approved the controversial Chat Control 1.0 regulation, requiring digital platforms to scan private communications for child sexual abuse material. The law sparks intense debate between child safety advocates and privacy defenders, who warn it undermines end-to-end encryption and sets a precedent for mass surveillance. Anyone concerned about digital rights and encryption should pay close attention to this development.

items.title: GPT-5.6
items.author: logickkk1
items.summary_zh: 关于GPT-5.6的传闻在开发者社区悄然升温，据称这是OpenAI内部测试的新一代模型，在推理效率和长文本处理上有显著提升。尽管官方未确认，但泄露的基准测试显示其在复杂编程和数学任务上超越了现有版本。如果属实，这将意味着AI模型在实用性和响应速度上迈入新台阶，对依赖语言模型的开发者和企业影响深远。
items.summary_en: Rumors about GPT-5.6, an alleged internal iteration from OpenAI, have sparked excitement in the developer community. Leaked benchmarks suggest it offers substantial improvements in reasoning efficiency and long-context handling, outperforming current models on complex coding and math tasks. While OpenAI hasn't confirmed the release, the speculation points to a possible leap in practical AI utility, making responses faster and more accurate. For developers and businesses relying on language models, even incremental upgrades can translate into better user experiences and lower latency. This potential release underscores the rapid pace of AI advancement.

items.title: Decoding the obfuscated bash script on a Uniqlo t-shirt
items.author: speerer
items.summary_zh: 一位技术爱好者解析了优衣库T恤上印制的混淆bash脚本，发现它实际上是一个恶作剧程序，通过复杂的字符串操作和陷阱逻辑来隐藏其真实功能。这篇分析展示了逆向工程乐趣，也提醒大家即使看似无害的代码也可能暗藏玄机。对于安全研究人员和编程爱好者来说，这是一次趣味与技术并重的解谜之旅。
items.summary_en: A tech enthusiast meticulously dissected an obfuscated bash script printed on a Uniqlo t-shirt, revealing it to be a playful prank program designed to confuse casual observers. The script uses intricate string manipulations and trap commands to mask its true purpose, which is simply to echo a message. This analysis highlights the fun side of reverse engineering and serves as a reminder that even innocuous-looking code can contain hidden complexity. It's a delightful read for security researchers and programming hobbyists who enjoy a good puzzle.
